label: Ensemble
description: Who is playing, and how many. The difference between a picture of an instrument and a picture of music being made.

items.name: solo-performer
items.text: a single performer alone with the instrument, no one else in the frame and nothing to hide behind
items.text_short: one performer alone with the instrument

items.name: duo
items.text: two players facing each other more than the audience, trading phrases and watching hands

items.name: string-quartet
items.text: a string quartet in a tight arc, four stands angled inward, bows moving as one line
items.text_short: string quartet in a tight arc, bows as one

items.name: jazz-trio
items.text: a jazz trio crowded into a corner, piano, bass and brushes, everyone within arm's reach of everyone else
items.text_short: jazz trio crowded into a corner

items.name: rock-band
items.text: a four-piece rock band spread across a stage, cables underfoot and monitors angled back, the drummer boxed in behind

items.name: big-band
items.text: a big band in tiered rows, sections standing to solo and sitting back down, matching stands across the front

items.name: symphony-orchestra
items.text: a full symphony orchestra fanned out under a conductor, strings forward and brass banked at the back, a hundred people watching one stick
items.text_short: full orchestra fanned under a conductor

items.name: choir
items.text: a choir massed in ranks, folders raised in unison, mouths in the same shape at the same instant
items.text_short: choir massed in ranks, folders raised

items.name: marching-band
items.text: a marching band mid-formation, sousaphone bells above the line, plumes moving together with the step

items.name: street-buskers
items.text: a busking group set up on a pavement, an open case seeded with coins, an amplifier running off a battery
items.text_short: buskers with an open case on the pavement

items.name: dj-solo
items.text: a DJ alone behind the decks with the booth lit from below, one hand on the crossfader and headphones on one ear
items.text_short: DJ alone behind the decks, one ear cupped

items.name: gamelan-ensemble
items.text: a gamelan ensemble seated on the floor around bronze keys and gongs, mallets damping each note by hand
items.text_short: gamelan seated around bronze and gongs

items.name: mariachi-group
items.text: a mariachi group standing in a half circle, silver-studded suits and a vihuela at the centre of the sound
items.text_short: mariachi in a half circle, silver-studded

items.name: folk-session
items.text: a pub folk session around a table rather than a stage, instruments passed along and pints between the tunes
items.text_short: folk session round a table, not a stage
